title: Functionalization of zeolite-encapsulated Cu5 clusters as visible-light photoactive sub-nanomaterials
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,2086-2098
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08633C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Katarzyna M. Krupka, Lenard L. Carroll, María Pilar de Lara-Castells
While TiO2 nanoparticles absorb in the UV of the solar spectrum, it is shown that zeolite-encapsulated Cu5–TiO2 nanoparticles absorb in the visible region via direct photo-induced electron transfers and formation of charge-separated states.
